name: walk_fwd50_long20_v1
description: Forward 50 mm/s with 20 s legs. Whole-body WALK on the floor with the scripted no-slip tripod gait (gait 1), measured by the overhead camera (chassis tag position and heading on the floor grid): mean speed, straight-line travel against the command, heading drift, tilt, total current. The loop stands the robot up itself, streams the gait command, stops, and sits it down. Forward 50 mm/s for 20 s then back, the same 20 s legs as walk_fwd30_long20_v1, so speed, drift and tilt compare directly against that run; commanded one-way distance 1000 mm (the camera view is about 1.2 m; the run stops early if the robot nears the edge).
